verdict.rationale: HubSpot's developer docs say you can create up to 10 test accounts to test apps and integrations without affecting real HubSpot data, which is a first-party isolated environment separate from production. This is real sandbox isolation, not a dry-run mode, but the evidence is a single line with little depth. Missing for 10: details on provisioning test accounts or seeding them with data, documented use of the MCP server or AI agents against test accounts, production-mirroring sandbox options, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: You can create up to 10 test accounts to test apps and integrations without affecting any real HubSpot data.
